challenge.better_approach: Checked making the hook test the exit code: it cannot tell a crash from a red (both non-zero) and bash has no trouble door. Catching in Python where the raiser already lives is the smallest move.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the trouble store is writable when the reseal crashes: a full /tmp does not fill ~/.cairn. If it is not, the traceback still prints and the hook still exits 0.
challenge.prior_art: reseal.py already raises per-proof troubles through ModuleRaiser (rung 3, timeouts, settled reds) and clears them on a standing check against the trouble store's live(); this reuses both. 357c402172ca and 143e3974647b own staging and kills.
challenge.real_collision: None: the 09-30 ruling forbids blocking, and this does not block. Distinction recorded: a kill (KeyboardInterrupt) stays 143e3974647b's.

answers.falsifier: A run raising OSError(ENOSPC) returns 3 and raises exactly one trouble under the key; a completed run keeps its code and clears only a standing trouble; a KeyboardInterrupt passes through raising nothing; the CLI goes through the door and the hook still exits 0. Wrong intent if the fix blocks the commit.
answers.how: Add reseal.run_or_record(run, raiser, standing): run the ladder; on an Exception print the traceback, raise trouble tester-reseal-could-not-run with the error and traceback tail, return 3; on completion clear that trouble if it stands. cli._reseal_run goes through it. The hook keeps || true and exit 0. KeyboardInterrupt passes through (143e3974647b owns a kill).
answers.traces_to: Law 7: errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces and permanent in records of truth; the 2026-09-30 ruling that the hook never blocks.
answers.what: A pre-commit reseal that crashes raises a trouble carrying the error, and the commit still lands.

bullets.text: Built in a worktree first: the new proof is green; two test_reseal_door teeth red there only because no CairnCommons sits beside a worktree, and the proof is green on main.

title: A pre-commit reseal that crashes raises a trouble carrying the error, and the commit still lands.
